verdict.rationale: Missive documents a built-in AI assistant that runs long sessions, shows its progress in a session tab, creates drafts, answers questions from the documentation, and can be extended with MCP tools. However, it runs only on the user's own Anthropic, OpenAI, or Gemini API key, and the range of delegable tasks is only sketched in changelog snippets. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on what tasks the assistant can carry out end-to-end, a bundled assistant that works without bring-your-own-key setup, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Long assistant sessions no longer need babysitting. The session tab now shows what the assistant is up to

Drafts created outside the composer, by the assistant, by a rule, or through the API and MCP server, now resolve {{ user.name }} and {{ user.email }} from your organization profile, exactly like the composer does.
Ask how a feature works, how to set up a rule, or where a setting lives. The answer comes straight from the Missive documentation instead of a guess.
The assistant runs on your own API key from Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google Gemini.
With custom MCP, you can connect any MCP-compatible server to Missive's AI assistant and let AI interact with your internal systems, proprietary data, or homegrown tools.
Your AI rules, saved models, and assistant conversations stay intact
